integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. Cool ceiling panels light the tiled horticulture workshop of a hospital day clinic. At the center of a steel bench a potted shrub has a flat fan of dry leaves on a slender stem leaning forward. A slot in front of the pot is longer than the fan but only a finger wide. Its balanced steel flap caps a ceramic-lined clipping box with a broad glass front, a solid back facing the workers and a small steady flame inside. A wood-based sand timer stands behind the pot. A smooth caliper lies on the left; closed pruning snips and one folded invoice with a perforated edge lie on the right. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: The flap is shut again. Behind the front glass the inverted fan crown rests on the ceramic bed; one leaf curls in the small flame. TEO holds the caliper clear at left, JUCA's right hand is empty beside the snips and folded invoice, and the doctor listens to the last of the sand. [Shot 1] Low frontal wide. The curled leaf darkens against its neighbor behind the glass. Above the opaque back of the box TEO turns the caliper upright, JUCA reaches for the folded invoice and the doctor keeps the stethoscope bell against the timer. [Shot 2] At 00:02.800, the camera cuts to Deep frontal medium. TEO seats the lower caliper tip on the pot rim and dips a shoulder until the upper one meets the stump. JUCA picks up the folded invoice with his right hand and offers it edge first. The doctor's right fingers close on its perforated corner before JUCA lets go. Below their hands flame travels across the inverted fan. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to Hold both levels in the wide. The last grain drops. The doctor draws the invoice to the timer; JUCA gives a short bow toward the doctor and TEO displays the gap. Behind the glass the last leaf catches, completing the original fan silhouette upside down in flame with a curling black fringe. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: From the left TEO holds the caliper to the finger-high stump; JUCA stands empty-handed at right beside the snips. The doctor holds the folded invoice beside the empty upper bulb of the sand timer. Below the shut flap the entire inverted fan crown burns behind intact glass, its leaf edges black and curled.
overall_soundscape: One dry leaf crackles faintly behind the thick glass at first; the steel caliper tip ticks lightly on the ceramic rim; perforated paper rasps against steel as JUCA lifts the invoice; the folded paper crinkles briefly in the doctor's grip; the whole dry crown crackles in a muffled rolling run at the last grain.
non_diegetic_music: Viola and bassoon bring back the opening pair of eighth notes very softly and settle into one tidy final chord.
